core_obligations: Reduce to Brauer groups (proof lines 10913-10918): via the comparison with Galois cohomology, the author reduces the assertion to the vanishing of Br(K') for every finite extension K' of K.

Reduce to finitely generated extensions (proof lines 10919-10927): writing K' as the filtered colimit of its finitely generated subextensions of transcendence degree one and using that the Brauer group commutes with this colimit, the author reduces to the function field of a curve over k, where the Brauer group vanishes by the corresponding result of the same chapter.
proof_roadmap: Translate to Galois cohomology and reduce to the vanishing of the Brauer groups of finite extensions.
Write such an extension as a filtered colimit of finitely generated subextensions and pass to the limit.
Apply the vanishing of the Brauer group for a function field of a curve.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the etale cohomology of the multiplicative group over a field of transcendence degree one over an algebraically closed field vanishes in positive degrees (statement lines 10906-10911). The proof translates the assertion into the vanishing of Brauer groups of finite extensions (proof lines 10913-10918) and then reduces to finitely generated extensions of transcendence degree one by writing the extension as a filtered colimit and using that Brauer groups commute with such colimits (proof lines 10919-10927), where the vanishing is the corresponding result for function fields of curves. The non-formal content is the colimit reduction. The claim is H2: two reductions, both written out.
